description: List every item in one module — Assignment, Page, Quiz, File, Discussion, ExternalUrl, ExternalTool or SubHeader — in module order, including each item's `published` state and unpublished items. Fetches every page (100 per request) and fails with a 'Results are incomplete' error instead of silently truncating. Use `list_modules` to find the module_id, `get_course_structure` for every module's items in one call, and `create_module_item`, `update_module_item` or `delete_module_item` to change what is inside.
name: list_module_items
title: List Module Items
